propositions: Eight GitHub Actions must be bumped to new major versions: checkout→v7, setup-python→v6, codeql-action→v4, upload-artifact→v7, cache→v6, download-artifact→v8, configure-aws-credentials→v6, terraform→v4 across 12 workflow files.
The bump is required due to GitHub's Node 24 runtime cutover (Node 20 support ends 2026-09-16).
actions/checkout v6 persist-credentials move to $RUNNER_TEMP broke reconcile-bridge linked-worktree pushes in v6.0.0, fixed in v6.0.1+ and v7.
All 12 affected workflow YAML files must remain valid and parse correctly after the version updates.
No changes to source code or test files are permitted; only .github/workflows/ modifications are in scope.
The Dependabot PR #119 must be merged via Gerrit since GitHub PRs cannot merge in this repository.
